text.p: Rain halted play in the second women's U.S. Open semifinal on Friday between top seeded and defending champion Steffi Graf and 16th seeded Martina Hingis.
Earlier, second seeded Monica Seles beat fourth-seeded Conchita Martinez of Spain 6-4 6-3.
After a rain delay of approximately three and a half hours, officials suspended the match.
Graf and Hingis will resume their semifinal on the Stadium Court at 11:00 a.m. (1500 gmt) with the Swiss teenager leading 1-0 in the first set and Graf serving.

The women's match will be followed by the men's semifinals with second-seed Michael Chang playing sixth-seeded Andre Agassi, and top-seeded defending champion Pete Sampras facing fourth seed Goran Ivanisevic.
